name: Astra Microwave Products Ltd
tagline: Defense/space RF-microwave subsystems maker with a genuine, well-documented indigenisation tailwind and a record ~Rs 4,300 Cr consolidated order book (incl. a Rs 2,205 Cr HAL Uttam Radar order), but already priced for perfection - ~84x trailing P/E, ~12x P/B, stock up ~51% in a year.
business_overview: Astra Microwave designs and manufactures RF/microwave subsystems for defense (radar, EW), space (ISRO) and meteorology/hydrology applications, with a board-approved in-principle plan to demerge the space/meteorology/hydrology business from the core defense business. Confirmed no pre-existing data file for this slug in this pass (state.json note flagged a possible prior research pass, but data/astra-microwave-products.json did not exist before this write-up).
fundamentals_table: Revenue ~Rs 1,140-1,163 Cr; Profit ~Rs 189 Cr (implied trailing P/E ~84x)
~6.54% - unusually low for an Indian listed company
Consolidated ~Rs 4,300 Cr incl. a Rs 2,205 Cr HAL order for Uttam Radar subsystems; standalone order book ~Rs 2,156 Cr as of 30-Jun-2026 (defense/PSU 71.3%, space 26.3%, exports 2.0%)
fundamentals_narrative: Astra Microwave is a genuine beneficiary of India's defense-indigenisation and export push, with a record order book (~Rs 4,300 Cr consolidated) anchored by a large HAL contract for Uttam Radar subsystems, plus a healthy 5-yr profit CAGR of ~46.2% and ROCE near 18%. The problem is valuation: at ~84x trailing earnings and ~12x book, with the stock already up ~51% over the past year, the market has priced in most of the visible order-book conversion. Promoter holding at only ~6.54% is a structural governance nuance (low founder skin-in-the-game) though not itself a red-flag-tier item (no pledge disclosed). A board-approved in-principle demerger of the space/meteorology/hydrology business adds execution complexity to track.
technical_read: Not pulled independently - stock has run up ~51% over 1 year and sits well off recent highs is not confirmed either way; valuation, not chart position, drives this call.
sentiment_summary: No forum deep-dive performed this pass given the 'neither' disposition driven by valuation (fast-triage budget).
bse_notes: No AVOID/EXCLUDE/HIGH CAUTION trigger - no pledged promoter holdings found, no auditor resignation or SEBI/fraud order surfaced. Low promoter holding (~6.54%) is noted as a governance characteristic to monitor, not a red flag.
bull_case: Record consolidated order book (~Rs 4,300 Cr) with a marquee Rs 2,205 Cr HAL order for Uttam Radar subsystems
Strong 5-yr profit CAGR (~46.2%) and healthy ROCE (~18.14%)
Genuine, policy-backed defense-indigenisation and export tailwind (Atmanirbhar Bharat), diversified into space (ISRO) work
No promoter pledge; planned demerger of space/meteorology/hydrology could unlock a cleaner defense-pure-play
bear_case: Valuation already very rich: ~84x trailing P/E, ~12x P/B, stock up ~51% in a year - little room for disappointment
Promoter holding unusually low (~6.54%) - less founder alignment than typical for the sector
ROE (~11.49%) lags ROCE (~18.14%), suggesting leverage/return-on-equity dynamics worth tracking
Pending demerger adds execution/structural complexity before any value-unlock is realised
verdict_headline: Genuine defense-indigenisation beneficiary with a record order book, but already priced for perfection (~84x P/E, ~12x P/B after a ~51% 1-year run-up) - four_box score 2.5 defaults to 'neither'. Conviction Medium given the strength of the underlying order book and growth despite the stretched valuation.
verdict_reasoning: four_box = 2.5 (tailwind yes - well-documented defense-indigenisation/export policy tailwind; tam yes - growing defense budget plus space/export diversification; moat weak - specialized RF/microwave capability and DRDO/ISRO/HAL relationships, tempered by unusually low promoter holding; valuation no - ~84x trailing P/E, ~12x P/B is very rich after a ~51% 1-year rally).
Score in the 2.0-2.5 band defaults to 'neither' per screen rules; no explicit exception written given how stretched the valuation already is relative to the (real) order-book growth.
No red flag found; conviction kept at Medium rather than higher given valuation risk, and rather than Low given the genuine order-book/earnings quality.
No forum deep-dive performed this pass given the fast-triage budget and the valuation-driven 'neither' call.

four_box.note: Genuine defense-indigenisation tailwind and TAM, with a record order book, but valuation (~84x P/E, ~12x P/B after a ~51% 1-year rally) is already very rich, and moat is tempered by unusually low (~6.54%) promoter holding.

quality_metrics.note: A genuine structural improvement, not a valuation-only story: ROCE has climbed from a trough of ~3% (FY19) through 11-19% (FY22-25) to 20% (FY26), while OPM has expanded from ~12% (FY22) to 29% (FY26). FCF conversion is strong (~90% of EBITDA, FY26). The quality is real; the 84x P/E is a separate, valid caution about how much of it is already paid for.

track_record.note: FY24 (+11.4% growth, ROCE 19%), FY25 (+15.6%, ROCE 19%) and FY26 (+10.7%, ROCE 20%) each cleared BOTH >=10% revenue growth AND >=15% ROCE; FY22 and FY23 (ROCE 11% and 17% respectively) did not clear on growth or ROCE - the last 3 years mark a genuine, recent step-up in consistency, not a decade-long trend.
